messages:
Mina Alvarez: Hey everyone! I’m Mina — joining as a Backend Infra Engineer. From Buenos Aires but currently in Lisbon. I love pancakes, late-night salsa, and I have two axolotls (Pico & Luna). Excited to dig into the runtime and meet folks. My timezone is WET (UTC+0); I’ll be around most mornings. :wave:
Talia (People Ops): Welcome, Mina!! :tada: We’ll get your badge and Mac set up today. Onboarding buddy is @sam_eng — he’ll DM you with a quick schedule.
Sam (Eng): hey Mina, stoked to have you. we usually do an unofficial pancake meetup on Fridays :pancakes: also happy to do a runtime deep-dive later this week.
Harper (DevEx): Hi Mina — if you like keyboards there’s a mech meetup on Thursday. also we have a sticker stash in the kitchen (ask Mike).
Mike (Facilities): Mina — badge queued, pick-up at 10:30 in the lobby. I’ll leave a desk plant if you want one. :seedling: also fridge rules: label food pls.
Jon: axolotls!!! pls post pics :eyes: (also, do they have names that are better than mine)
Mina Alvarez: Pics incoming. they’re messy eaters but very photogenic. also shameless plug — i make a mean dulce de leche pancake, open to recipe trades. :yum:
Sasha (Design): welcome!! if you want a Lisbon cafe rec ping me — obsessed with flat whites ☕
Talia (People Ops): quick FYI: welcome zoom later today at 14:00 UTC, calendar invite sent. everyone — drop 1 quick tip for Mina in the thread :smile:
Sam (Eng): tip: Ctrl+S is your friend. also ask me about prefix caching; it’ll make your life easier.
Harper (DevEx): tip: join #eng-runtime for mem-optim tricks. check the onboarding checklist in Notion and mark off anything you finish.
Mina Alvarez: thanks everyone! can’t wait to meet IRL — i’ll bring pancake swag for the first in-person day :grin:
welcome-bot: Mina Alvarez joined the workspace. Welcome pack shipped: sticker bundle, hoodie, plant.
